about.title: What is Neuromundi?
about.body1: Neuromundi is a global community and marketplace for neurodivergence. We connect families and neurodivergent people with service providers, merchants and inclusive schools, plus a directory of vetted professionals, a store of products and resources, and an academy with courses.
about.body2: Families and neurodivergent people register and use the platform for free. Neuromundi’s purpose is to make quality support easier to find—with real reviews, trustworthy information and safe tools—all in one place.

search.free: Registration is free for families and neurodivergent people.

home.community: We’re not just another directory — we’re a genuine community of support, guidance and companionship, created by patients and families together with specialists and providers focused on neurodevelopment and neurodivergence. This is your space to grow with inclusion.

rules.title: Rules and liability disclaimer
rules.intro: These rules govern each user type's participation in Neuromundi. By registering you agree to follow them. Neuromundi connects users with each other and does NOT provide health services or sell products itself.
rules.patientIntro: As a patient you agree to:
patientRules: Provide truthful information when registering and requesting services.
Treat professionals, providers and other members with respect.
Understand that community recommendations do not replace professional health advice.
Not share login credentials or impersonate others.
rules.parentIntro: As a parent/guardian you agree to:
parentRules: Act in the best interest of the minor or person in your care.
Give informed authorization for data sharing between specialists when applicable.
Verify credentials and references of the professionals and providers you choose.
Safeguard any clinical information you receive.
rules.serviceIntro: As a professional you agree to:
serviceRules: Hold the training, licenses and permits required by your jurisdiction.
Provide truthful information about your experience, services and fees.
Comply with applicable health, tax and data-protection regulations.
Keep patient and family information confidential.
Be solely responsible for the services you provide through the platform.
rules.merchantIntro: As a provider you agree to:
merchantRules: Describe your products or services truthfully and without deception.
Meet warranty, invoicing and delivery obligations to the buyer.
Comply with applicable consumer and data-protection regulations.
Be solely responsible for the products or services you offer.
Every product you publish is reviewed by Neuromundi and becomes visible in the store only after approval (review commitment within a maximum of 24 hours).
"Miracle products" or claims of cure, diagnosis, or guaranteed results regarding neurodevelopmental conditions are not allowed.
Neuromundi reserves the right and authority to remove or suspend any product from the store at any time, at its discretion.
rules.disclaimerBody: Neuromundi acts solely as a technology facilitator connecting users. It is not a health provider, issues no diagnoses or treatments, does not sell the listed products and is not a party to the relationships, transactions or agreements between users.
disclaimerPoints: Neuromundi does not guarantee the suitability, quality, legality or outcomes of services, products, advice, blogs, courses or content published by third parties.
Health decisions are the responsibility of the user and the professionals they choose; in an emergency, seek medical services.
Transactions, payments and deliveries occur between users; Neuromundi is not liable for breaches, damages or losses arising from them.
Content (blogs, videos, courses, Academy) is the responsibility of its author and is informational; it does not replace professional care.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, Neuromundi shall not be liable for direct, indirect or incidental damages arising from use of the platform.
rules.acceptanceNote: By checking the acceptance box at registration, you confirm you have read and accept these rules and disclaimer. Your acceptance, with its version and date, is recorded.

hero.title: Your data and your family’s are safe with Neuromundi
hero.b1: You are the sole owner of your information
hero.b3: We never sell or share your data

own.title: You are the only owner of your data
own.body: The information you share —yours or your child’s— belongs to you. We don’t sell it or hand it to third parties, clinics or other specialists. It is encrypted and stays protected.

sep.title: Your data, separated and protected
sep.card1Body: Never sold or shared. No unwanted marketing. No one sees your private information except those you authorize for your care.
sep.card2Body: Treated as sensitive data, only with your explicit consent and for a clear purpose. You can withdraw consent anytime.

sec.title: Professional-grade security
sec.body: Your information travels and is stored encrypted, with backups, access control and per-user isolation via database-level security policies. Infrastructure runs on leading cloud providers.

law.title: We comply with current regulations
law.body: We apply the principles of the world’s main data-protection laws: minimization, purpose limitation and transparency. These are your rights:

p1.title: Secure, yet flexible
p1.body: You decide what you share and with whom. Grant a specialist access when you need it and revoke it later.

p2.title: Encrypted, yet accessible
p2.body: Your data is encrypted and still available to you securely from any place or device.

p3.title: Useful, yet responsible
p3.body: We use your information only to serve you better. We never send unwanted promotions.

howto.title: How to use this tool
familyClinical: Authorize a specialist to share the record: pick one from the list and grant consent.
Select the authorized specialist to view the record, message them and attach files.
Log milestones and progress in the tracker; they are saved on your device.
providerClinical: Families that granted you consent appear here.
Choose a family to open their record.
Write notes, attach files and follow up from the record.
parentQr: Show this QR code to the provider to apply a discount or log a consultation.
The provider scans it with their account; you'll see the transaction instantly.
After redeeming, answer the short satisfaction survey.
scan: Tap scan and point the camera at the customer's QR.
Confirm the offer or consultation to apply.
The transaction is recorded; the customer will get the survey.
prescriptions: Here you see prescriptions or indications sent by specialists.
Open them for details; mark them as ordered when you fill the product.
You can download or share them with your provider.
lists: Create lists to save favorite providers or resources.
Add items from the directory with the save button.
Share a list via link whenever you want.
appointments: Here you see your booked appointments with providers.
Open an appointment to view details or cancel it.
Book new appointments from the provider's profile.
agenda: Set your availability and service hours.
Review and confirm appointments requested by users.
content: Tap 'New' to create a blog article or a link.
Fill in title, topic, excerpt and content; add keywords.
Publish when ready; you can unpublish or edit it later.
courses: Tap create to add a course or workshop.
Add title, cover, level and the lessons.
Publish it so it appears in Academy.
affiliate: This program rewards whoever promotes YOUR Store products.
Set your code and the commission percentage you will pay per sale.
Share the link: anyone buying through it generates the commission.
Here you see the sales achieved and the accrued commission; settlement happens outside the app.
network: Search and connect with other professionals or providers.
Collaborate and share referrals with your network.
offers: Tap 'New offer' and set the discount and its validity.
Publish it so it appears to families on your profile.
When they redeem the QR, you'll see the use in your history.
payments: Connect your payout account to receive payments.
Set your consultation amount and currency.
Check the status of your received payments here.
recommend: Copy your recommendation link or tap 'Share'.
Send it via WhatsApp, email or social media to anyone Neuromundi could help.
When that person signs up with your link, it adds to your recommendation count.
prescribe: Choose or search the recipient patient/family.
Add the products or indications and usage notes.
Send the prescription; the patient sees it in their account and can mark it as ordered.
history: Filter by status or offer to narrow what you need.
Each row is a redemption: date, offer applied and status.
Use “Export” to download the history as CSV for your bookkeeping.
waitlist: Add patients by their member ID (NM-000123) and an optional note.
If an appointment is rejected or cancelled, the platform notifies those waiting automatically.
To offer a slot outside that case, use “Announce a free slot”.
When you fit someone in, mark them Assigned to remove them from the list.
campaigns: Write a short, clear subject and message.
Choose the audience: your waitlist or your patients.
Pick the channels: in-app notification, email and/or SMS (SMS has a per-message cost).
Press Send; the log below shows how many people received it.

csv.title: Import and export fees (CSV)
csv.hint: Configure many countries at once: download what you have, edit it in Excel or Google Sheets, and upload it back. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

csv.errorsNote: Those rows are skipped; the rest are imported.
csv.replaceHint: Deletes fees not present in the file. Leave unchecked to only add and update what the file contains.
csv.formatBody: One row per country, affiliate type and member class. Annual equals 10 months and the reference 12; leave them empty and they are derived from the monthly amount.
csv.formatNote: Accepts ";" or "," as separator and comma decimals. The country may carry accents: "México" and "Mexico" are the same.
